mapper.select: SELECT B.ID AS bindingRefId, B.ROLE_REF_ID AS roleRefId, B.SCOPE_TYPE AS scopeType, B.SCOPE_REF_ID AS scopeRefId, P.PERMISSION_CODE AS permissionCode FROM PEACH_MEMBER_ROLE_BINDING B INNER JOIN PEACH_TENANT_MEMBER M ON M.ID = B.MEMBER_REF_ID AND M.TENANT_REF_ID = B.TENANT_REF_ID AND M.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND M.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_TENANT T ON T.ID = B.TENANT_REF_ID AND T.STATUS = 'ENABLE' AND T.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_APPLICATION A ON A.ID = B.APP_REF_ID AND A.TENANT_ID = T.TENANT_ID AND A.IS_OPEN = 1 AND A.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_ROLE R ON R.ID = B.ROLE_REF_ID AND R.TENANT_REF_ID = B.TENANT_REF_ID AND R.APP_REF_ID = B.APP_REF_ID AND R.AUTH_YEAR = B.AUTH_YEAR AND R.ROLE_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND R.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_ROLE_PERMISSION RP ON RP.ROLE_REF_ID = R.ID AND RP.TENANT_REF_ID = B.TENANT_REF_ID AND RP.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND RP.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_PERMISSION_DEFINITION P ON P.ID = RP.PERMISSION_REF_ID AND P.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND P.IS_DELETE = 0 AND (P.APP_REF_ID IS NULL OR P.APP_REF_ID = B.APP_REF_ID) AND ((P.OWNER_TYPE = 'SYSTEM' AND P.TENANT_REF_ID IS NULL) OR (P.OWNER_TYPE = 'TENANT' AND P.TENANT_REF_ID = B.TENANT_REF_ID)) WHERE B.TENANT_REF_ID = #{tenantRefId} AND B.MEMBER_REF_ID = #{memberRefId} AND B.APP_REF_ID = #{appRefId} AND B.AUTH_YEAR = #{year} AND B.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND B.IS_DELETE = 0 AND P.PERMISSION_CODE = #{permissionCode}

SELECT DISTINCT P.PERMISSION_CODE FROM PEACH_PERMISSION_DEFINITION P WHERE P.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'API' AND P.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND P.IS_DELETE = 0 AND (P.APP_REF_ID IS NULL OR P.APP_REF_ID = #{appRefId}) AND ((P.OWNER_TYPE = 'SYSTEM' AND P.TENANT_REF_ID IS NULL) OR (P.OWNER_TYPE = 'TENANT' AND P.TENANT_REF_ID = #{tenantRefId})) AND P.PERMISSION_CODE LIKE CONCAT(#{method}, ':/%') ORDER BY P.PERMISSION_CODE LIMIT 513

SELECT B.ID AS bindingRefId, B.ROLE_REF_ID AS roleRefId, B.SCOPE_TYPE AS scopeType, B.SCOPE_REF_ID AS scopeRefId, P.PERMISSION_CODE AS permissionCode FROM PEACH_MEMBER_ROLE_BINDING B INNER JOIN PEACH_TENANT_MEMBER M ON M.ID = B.MEMBER_REF_ID AND M.TENANT_REF_ID = B.TENANT_REF_ID AND M.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND M.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_TENANT T ON T.ID = B.TENANT_REF_ID AND T.STATUS = 'ENABLE' AND T.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_APPLICATION A ON A.ID = B.APP_REF_ID AND A.TENANT_ID = T.TENANT_ID AND A.IS_OPEN = 1 AND A.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_ROLE R ON R.ID = B.ROLE_REF_ID AND R.TENANT_REF_ID = B.TENANT_REF_ID AND R.APP_REF_ID = B.APP_REF_ID AND R.AUTH_YEAR = B.AUTH_YEAR AND R.ROLE_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND R.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_ROLE_PERMISSION RP ON RP.ROLE_REF_ID = R.ID AND RP.TENANT_REF_ID = B.TENANT_REF_ID AND RP.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND RP.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_PERMISSION_DEFINITION P ON P.ID = RP.PERMISSION_REF_ID AND P.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND P.IS_DELETE = 0 AND (P.APP_REF_ID IS NULL OR P.APP_REF_ID = B.APP_REF_ID) AND ((P.OWNER_TYPE = 'SYSTEM' AND P.TENANT_REF_ID IS NULL) OR (P.OWNER_TYPE = 'TENANT' AND P.TENANT_REF_ID = B.TENANT_REF_ID)) WHERE B.TENANT_REF_ID = #{tenantRefId} AND B.MEMBER_REF_ID = #{memberRefId} AND B.APP_REF_ID = #{appRefId} AND B.AUTH_YEAR = #{year} AND B.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND B.IS_DELETE = 0 AND P.PERMISSION_CODE = #{permissionCode} AND P.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'API'
